selection.method: Score each surviving P43 unresolved lead using P25/P39/P45/P47 individual prior audit provenance, inherited discovery count, named-building typology, and open mapping OSM hints; subtract scope ambiguity and special reviews. Select highest 150 with stable original-order tiebreak.
selection.p48_dependency: P48 remains separate PR #1733. Eight P48 proposed candidate IDs excluded from research queue to prevent concurrent duplicate effort; do not describe 364 as current merged count until P48 merges.

deduplication_adjudications.basis: The existing canonical Aachen Place has verified cathedral site coordinates and UNESCO site provenance; new exact OSM way 20470246 denotes the same physical cathedral; do not duplicate devotional title
Existing live Place already has exact same OSM way 107938444 as the proposed source lead

protected_holds.reason: Historical inventory country code IE for St Patrick's Cathedral Armagh conflicts with Northern Ireland GB physical location and named Catholic OSM way 91239601; hold before any new Place/area assignment

policy: This is a prioritized geometry-acquisition worklist, NOT 150 newly geocoded or independently verified locations.
Source URLs from prior research are carried with their original issuers and review flags; a historical URL is not freshly revalidated.
OSM object hints are unverified candidates and never become Place.geo until the exact Catholic building object is independently established.
Existing canonical reuse must not create duplicates. Country mismatch is never silently rewritten.
Sourcing, building identity and exact OSM way/relation geometry are release gates, followed by existing canonical IDs, crosswalk, source and CI tests.
